maria: Heads up — discovered ~72h of late ingest for EU aggregate-hours (2026-03-10 → 2026-03-13). Looks like GC lag + S3 partition retry. Need a recompute plan.
jamal: Ugh. How big is the delta? token estimate / rows?
maria: Rough numbers: ~1.1M affected keys, ~14M events, estimate ~120k compute-tokens if we do hourly reslice. Cost ~1.2k USD using current pricing.
alex: Can we do daily slices instead to save overhead? hourly increases kernel warmups.
maria: Daily would reduce task count but increases per-task memory/seq length. Risk of OOM in some workers.
sashi: What if we hybrid: daily for low-cardinality tenants, hourly for high-card shards? Console should surface per-tenant slice suggestion.
jamal: We should also consider routing policy: route backfills to dedicated capacity pool to avoid SLO regressions on prod. Any free spot in dedicated this week?
alex: Dedicated has a 10% left in EU pool for the weekend. We can request burst, but ops approval needed.
sashi: Prefer quota-based fair-share instead of hard-routing — set cluster backfill quota to 15% peak, with auto-evict if latency > SLO.
maria: Agree on fair-share. Also need KV-cache invalidation for prefix recompute — otherwise aggregates will be inconsistent until TTL expires.
jamal: Good call. KV invalidation step adds ~10% more to the runtime because downstream reads will repopulate caches.
alex: Console UX ask: preflight dry-run shows estimated token usage, approximate cost, and a small graph of hot tenants. Also allow locking a tenant to prevent concurrent manual runs.
maria: I ran a dry-run command locally: `recompute --start 2026-03-10 --end 2026-03-13 --slice hourly --dryrun`
alex: Can you paste the dry-run summary output?
maria: `DRYRUN: tasks=168, est_tokens=118400, est_cost_usd=1184, peak_parallelism=32 (with hourly)`. Also `hot_tenants=[acct:acme: 22% of tokens, acct:neo 12%]`.
sashi: If acme is that hot, we should cap per-tenant window to 8 hours max concurrency or apply tenant-specific throttles.
jamal: SLO concern: backfills can spike RPC latency. Suggest staging window: run during 03:00-09:00 UTC and apply preemptive throttles when p95 latency > 200ms.
ops-bot: notice: job plan accepted to queue (job_id: backfill-3187654321-dryrun).
maria: Also think about dedupe idempotency — we must ensure recompute writes are idempotent for upserts. Last time we had a dup leading to double-count.
alex: Add an idempotency token derived from (shard_id, window_start, job_run_id). Console should show the token so SRE can audit.
sashi: Rollout UX: offer canary windows: run 1% tenants first for 1 hour, then 10%, then full. Console could give a 3-step button.
jamal: Canary is fine but it's extra effort. If we route to dedicated pool, we can do broader rollout faster. Tradeoff: cost vs safety.
maria: Another option: reslice logic that coalesces adjacent empty slices to reduce tasks; many slices are empty for low-card tenants.
alex: Good idea. Implement `sparse_slice_compaction` in the orchestration layer. Might reduce tasks by ~35%.
sashi: For fairness, add a weighted queue in the scheduler: backfill jobs get weight 0.2 of production traffic by default, adjustable per-customer.
maria: We need observability: dashboard panels for backfill progress, est vs actual tokens, per-tenant token burn, and alert if actual > est * 1.25.
jamal: +1 on alert. Also notify product and support for hot tenants so they can expect output changes.
alex: If we need a fast mitigation: we can implement `preempt_to_shared` fallback to push backfill off shared nodes when pressure spikes.
sashi: Let's formalize an operator runbook: preflight dry-run -> request dedicated burst -> start canary 1% -> monitor p95/queue depth/cost -> scale up to 10% -> full. Add kill-switch: `backfill pause` that drains new tasks immediately.
maria: I'll draft the runbook and a console preflight UI spec. Will ping infra for dedicated burst.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: requested burst for dedicated pool (ticket #INC-9876).
jamal: Timeline?
maria: I'll aim to start canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC if burst approved.
alex: I'll sketch the console mock for preflight and canary controls and drop in Figma link later. :eyes:  
sashi: I'll open a scheduler PR for weighted queues + sparse_slice_compaction.
maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the burst ticket update. :thumbsup:
